page.overview:
Who is Abdul Smith?

Originally a shoeshine boy with a bank account containing only five dollars, a mistake at the bank added 500,000 dollars to his account. He was able to invest that money in the stock exchange, earning enough money to return the original sum to the bank and keep a cool million for himself.
